params.message:
Stem: pick the werf app's voice by listening, without a deploy

The conversation's voice was VOICE_NAME in .env: changing it took a deploy,
and nobody could hear the options first. A new admin page, Stem (in the user
menu next to Gebruikers), lists the ten voices gpt-realtime speaks with. Each
has a play button for a Dutch sample sentence and a Kies button. The choice
is stored in a new settings table and holds from the next conversation on;
.env stays the fallback until somebody chooses.

Samples come from OpenAI's speech endpoint (gpt-4o-mini-tts) with the same
voices, made once per voice and sentence and kept on the private disk.

Needs php artisan migrate (settings table).
